propositions: Core commands across ticket, store, read/write, config, import/export, maintenance, and gate subsystems currently parse argv imperatively and duplicate grammar definitions that should be centralized.

Each core command must migrate its grammar to a S2a-compliant side-effect-free argparse factory in src/rebar/_cli/_parsers/core/, wire the parser_factory reference onto its Route in _registry.py, and route its _dispatch_* handler through that factory.

Per-family unknown-token semantics (parse_known_args skip vs reject-with-exit-2) must be preserved through migration, proven by negative tests; router global-flag extraction (--output, --quiet, --allow-secret-pattern) runs before per-command factories and is never re-declared.

Accepted/rejected argv matrices must cover missing/surplus values, space/equal options, --, global output extraction, and malformed input; existing persisted effects, diagnostics, exit codes, and streams must show no unapproved behavior delta verified through real production-path tests.

Parser construction must import no domain executor or optional dependency, and real selected execution must resolve no unrelated parser factory or handler, proven by construction-exclusion probe and dispatch-isolation assertion.

All 49 core Routes must carry a parser_factory and no unrelated parser factories or handlers must be constructed during execution; metrics is excluded as already migrated; completion includes 56/56 parity oracle tests green, 817 interface tests passed, and module-size policy compliance.
